subject: POC credit safety net request: overnight latency/throughput soak
content:
From: Diane Lewis <diane.lewis@clevercart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Jul 2028 23:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC night soak — request for short-term credit buffer

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call earlier — the team at CleverCart is ready to run the overnight latency/throughput soak you suggested. We plan to run a 10-hour window starting 02:00 PT Monday to validate tail-latency under synthetic peak traffic (spikes up to 6k req/s).

Before we kick off we need a short-term credit buffer to ensure we can complete the run without throttling. Can you do a one-off top-up (or promo credit) to cover a ~100k token equivalent? We expect most load will be short generations (avg 35 tokens). If helpful, I attached a quick MAP that outlines the goals.

Appreciate a quick yes/no — we want to start the soak on Monday night PST.

Best,
Diane
Director of Platform
CleverCart

--- Attachment: CleverCart_MAP_v1.pdf (pdf, 210KB)

--------
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Diane Lewis <diane.lewis@clevercart.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC night soak — request for short-term credit buffer

Diane — thanks for the quick MAP and context. This sounds like a standard preflight: overnight soak to validate tail-latency and auto-scaling under short bursts.

Quick notes / proposal:
- We can provision a temporary credit allowance for the window. Asking operations: would you accept a capped allowance (100k token-equivalent) and we'll disable overage so the run won't unexpectedly stop.
- I'll loop in Jonas for a quick approval and Ben for ops sizing.
- If you confirm the exact start/end times and a target qps profile, we can set the quota and hand off the confirmation link before midnight.

Jonas — can we approve a one-time promotional top-up to the CleverCart POC (deal DL-7432)? If finance needs a formal sign-off, I can attach the SLA exception template.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

--------
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Diane Lewis <diane.lewis@clevercart.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC night soak — request for short-term credit buffer

Looping in with operational details. For a 10-hour window at the profile Diane described (spikes to 6k rps, avg gen 35 tokens):
- Estimated consumption: ~105k token-equivalent (includes retries and KV-cache warmups).
- Recommend provisioning 120k equivalent to provide a 15% buffer.
- Implementation path: transient promo-credit code scoped to the account + disable auto-billing and alert on 80% burn.

I've uploaded the SLA exception doc and a short checklist; attaching both. If marketing wants to keep this as a success story we can also include pro-bono engineering hours for the initial taper.

Ben Carter
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
--- Attachment: SLA-exception-request.docx (docx, 45KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Diane Lewis <diane.lewis@clevercart.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 08:49:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC night soak — request for short-term credit buffer

Approve the top-up as a one-off promotional allowance to close DL-7432's preflight. Approve 120k token equivalent as Ben recommended.

Two asks before I confirm the credit dispatch:
1) Finance approval: Can someone confirm there are no outstanding billing disputes on CleverCart (Marissa/Ben)? If not, I'll greenlight the promo code.
2) Please publish the burn alert threshold to the account (80%) and assign an on-call contact from CleverCart so we can pause if needed.

If both items are OK, I'll push the promo code and set it to expire 24 hours after the soak window.

Jonas Weber
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

Marissa
